title: Gift ideas
audience: For anyone who hears the perfect gift idea in March and forgets it by December.
description: A free gift list in a note: ideas for each person, birthdays and Christmas with a budget each, and what's coming up. Tell your AI when you hear an idea.
tagline: Ideas by person, budgets and what's next.
note:
Gift ideas

Your list lives in the app: everyone you buy for, their birthdays and Christmas with a budget each, every idea from heard to given, and what's coming up. Tell your AI the moment you hear an idea and it saves it under the right person.

## How we do gifts
What your family agreed: limits, Secret Santa, who buys for whom. Your AI keeps to it when it suggests a gift.

## Thank-yous
Who gave you what, so you remember to say thanks.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Gift ideas". It is an app, with its data in "Gift ideas.app/data.json". Read it with fetch before each change; change it with edit. People are values.people: { id, name, likes, sizes, has, occasions: [{ id, kind, date: "mm-dd", budget }] }, kind birthday, christmas, anniversary or other. When I mention an idea, add { id, person: their id, title, price as a number, shop, link, occasion if I said one, status: "idea" } to values.ideas. When I buy, wrap or give one, set status to bought, wrapped or given. When I ask what to get someone, use their likes, sizes and has, their next budget less what's bought, and never a gift with status given.

asks: Ask who I buy gifts for and when their birthdays are, then set up my gift list.
Mum would love that blue scarf from Arket, 450 kr.
What should I get Oskar for under 300?
